objectives.title: Forge the proof
objectives.prompt: Convince the verifier that you know the plaintext and read its message.
hints: The challenge bits come from MD5 of your own commitments.
What can you choose before the bits are fixed?

steps.title: Name the transform
steps.prompt: Which transform turns the interactive proof into a non-interactive one?

steps.title: Identify the hash
steps.prompt: Which hash function derives the challenge bits?

steps.title: Identify the cryptosystem
steps.prompt: Squaring modulo n encrypts the message: which cryptosystem is that?

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: Which weakness of that hash helps you control the challenge bits?
